The first '''Moff of the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]''' was a man who tried to defy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
The [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] conspired to run the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] independently for his own profit.
In response to this, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a [[Star Destroyer task force|task force]] to remove him. When a substantial fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] appeared over the capital, he tried to declared his loyalty to the Empire, but was arrested. On the same day, he and his sector administration were tried for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] and executed.

After his death, the position of Moff was given to [[Nebin Cray]].
